text:
Nah, AMD simply doesn't want spend too many precious 7nm wafers for cheap graphics cards. They could but then extra GPUs made would eat zen2 production which is a lot more lucrative right now. AMD can make one 3900X/3950X or two 3700X/3800X out of same area as one Navi14. And AMD has to share profits with AIBs while CPUs generate full revenue. Navi10 cards are fine, GPU die is only 100mm^2 bigger(+67%) but cards are about twice as expensive and they don't sell that many units as $200 class cards.
7nm production choke will improve, AMD is supposed to double their wafer share during this year. Apple and other mobile companies are going to jump to 5nm for their flagship socs and overall 7nm production increase 30%. I'd expect navi cards to get cheaper second half of year. Right now TSMC's 7nm lead time is still 6 months, that's how far it's booked right now.
